title: Model health as a state machine with typed failure classes
goal: Classify every provider response and transport failure into a typed class - auth rejected, rate limited, timeout, server error, context overflow, content filtered, malformed - and drive a per-model and per-key health state through it: healthy, cooling until a deadline that honours Retry-After, degraded, key-dead, out of quota. A timeout or a rate limit must never be recorded as a capability failure (that is the whole point of the split); a genuine wrong answer must never be recorded as unavailability. The state is observable and survives a restart.
